about_the_game:
🌊 A relaxing hidden object adventure set across the Mediterranean.

Whether you want to unwind after a long day or challenge yourself to beat your high scores, this game adapts to your mood. The beautiful Mediterranean settings transport you to sunny coastlines, while the tight gameplay mechanics keep you engaged and rewarded for skillful play.

With 40 stages, multiple mini-games, and bonus content to discover, there's plenty to explore. And with brief location facts peppered throughout, you'll even learn something new about Mediterranean culture!

⭐ Add it to your Wishlist and enjoy a relaxing hidden-object adventure when it launches.

⭐ What Steam Curators Say:

"Summer Adventurers: Mediterranean is een cozy en rustig zoek spelletje dat wat aan de gemakkelijkere kant is. Wat ook wel een keertje mag. Je kan ook timed spelen. Heel leuk. Video laat gameplay zien." - Calm

"Puzzle game. Find 23 hidden items in every scenic stage! Search fast and smart to build combo chains for higher scores. Enjoy a mini-game every 2 stages. 40 stages in total!" — Good Game Collections

"Relax and explore the Mediterranean in a charming hidden-object adventure. Find cleverly hidden items, solve mini-puzzles, and uncover bonus sublevels filled with secrets!" — Universal Gamers

"A short hidden-object game with 40 varied levels, HO scenes with item lists, collectibles, and minigames. Travel-themed, with brief location facts before each stage for a light educational touch." — Review Score Pollution

"A cozy and relaxing game, perfect for unwinding after a long day. Beautiful visuals and light puzzles create a calm, pleasant atmosphere." — GameSpectrum

"Исследуйте 40 потрясающих мест Средиземноморья и отточите свою наблюдательность! На каждом этапе вам предстоит найти 23 хитро спрятанных предмета. Открывайте мини-игры каждые 2 уровня и исследуйте..." — Mix Games Fever 

🎮 Key Features

40 Unique Mediterranean Stages Journey through breathtaking locations inspired by the Mediterranean coast. Each stage features scenes with authentic architectural details and cultural elements.

23 Hidden Items Per Stage. Test your observation skills by finding 23 carefully concealed objects in every scene. Items blend naturally into environments, offering the perfect balance of challenge and satisfaction.

Combo Chain System. Find items quickly to build combo chains and maximize your score! The faster you spot objects, the higher your multiplier climbs. Can you achieve the perfect combo on every stage?

Mini-Games Every 2 Stages Break up the hidden object action with engaging mini-puzzles that test different skills. These varied challenges add depth and variety to your Mediterranean journey.

Bonus Sublevels. Discover secret bonus stages filled with extra collectibles and challenges. Completionists will love uncovering every hidden corner of the game!

Educational Travel Facts. Learn fascinating facts about Mediterranean locations before each stage. Enjoy a light educational element while you play!

 Dual Gameplay Modes

  • Relaxation Mode: Take your time, enjoy the beautiful artwork, and unwind with calm puzzle-solving

  • Challenge Mode: Race against time, chase high scores, and master the combo system

🎯 Perfect For

✓ Fans of hidden object and seek-and-find games ✓ Players who love Mediterranean culture and travel ✓ Anyone seeking a relaxing yet engaging puzzle experience ✓ Score chasers who enjoy combo-based gameplay ✓ Completionists hunting for every secret and collectible.

☕ Ready to unwind? Add the game to your Wishlist and enjoy it when it’s ready.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4096 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 / AMD Radeon R5
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 2048x1152 resolution. Game runs on most modern systems.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Full HD or higher resolution recommended for best experience.
